role.admin.context: The account role 'Admin', shown under the account's name. A fixed role name; translate it consistently everywhere.

session.my_account.context: Opens the signed-in person's own profile dialog.

session.my_account.named.context: Accessible name of the header account button.

session.my_account.role.context: Accessible name of the header account button when the account has no display name.

session.my_account.tooltip.context: Tooltip of the sidebar's account entry: its full display name (shown here when too long for the row), its role, then what it opens.

session.my_account.tooltip_role.context: Tooltip of the sidebar's account entry before the display name is read.

common.not_saved.context: A save failed and the server gave no reason.

dialog.close.context: Closes a dialog that only informs (help, details); also the upper-right close control's name.

dialog.confirm.context: Default accept of a confirmation dialog whose owner names no action.

dialog.confirm_action.context: Default title of a confirmation dialog whose owner names none.

dialog.type_to_confirm.context: Above the field of a destructive confirmation; {phrase} is a fixed word the person must type exactly (for example WIPE) and is never translated.

args.phrase: string: the literal word to type, untranslated

dialog.edit_value.context: Default title of a one-field edit dialog whose owner names none.

account.title.context: Title of the signed-in person's own profile dialog.
account.title.geometry: Wraps between words at 320px (two lines at most) beside the Help chip and the Easy | Advanced control.

account.signin.required.context: Line under My Account's title on a Standalone installation: sign-in is on now.
account.signin.required.geometry: Centred on its own row at 320px.

account.signin.not_required.context: Line under My Account's title on a Standalone installation: sign-in is off now, so anyone who can reach it uses it.
account.signin.not_required.geometry: Centred on its own row at 320px.

account.help.context: Help chip in My Account's header: opens My Account's help.

account.field.username.context: Read-only DebridPulse sign-in name (Server only). 'DP' is DebridPulse's abbreviation; keep it.

account.field.display_name.context: The name DebridPulse shows for this person.

account.field.actual_name.context: The person's real name, optional profile information.

account.field.email.placeholder.context: Example address; may be localized to a typical example address.

account.field.email.edit.context: Pencil that turns the shown email into an editable field.

account.field.current_password.context: The password the account has now.

account.field.confirm_password.context: The new password again, to catch typing errors.

account.action.change_password.context: Opens the view that changes an existing password.

account.action.set_password.context: Opens the view that sets a first password for an account that has none.

account.action.clear_password.context: Destructive: removes the Standalone Administrator's password and turns password sign-in off.

account.first_password.note.standalone.context: Under Set Password on an open Standalone installation.

account.first_password.note.server.context: Under Set Password for an account that signs in through an identity provider.

account.clear.consequence.context: The consequence of Clear Password, in the view and in its confirmation. Keep every part: password sign-in turns off; anyone who can reach DebridPulse gets in; until a new password is set.

account.clear.confirm_title.context: Title of the confirmation before clearing the password.

account.validation.current_password.context: Clear Password was pressed without the current password.

account.validation.new_password.context: Set Password was pressed without a password.

account.validation.passwords_differ.context: New and Confirm New Password differ.

account.validation.current_and_new.context: Change Password was pressed with a field empty.

account.validation.display_name.context: Save was pressed with an empty display name.

presentation.label.context: Accessible name of the Easy | Advanced control.

presentation.easy.context: The simpler presentation choice. One short word: it shares a compact two-part control with Advanced.
presentation.easy.geometry: Both labels in full at 320px, inside one two-part control.

presentation.advanced.context: The full presentation choice (everything role and deployment allow).
presentation.advanced.geometry: Both labels in full at 320px, inside one two-part control.

presentation.status.not_saved.context: Announced when a presentation choice could not be saved; the choice returns to the saved one.

presentation.status.saving.context: Announced while a presentation choice is being saved.

presentation.status.saved.context: Announced once a presentation choice is saved.

presentation.status.unavailable.context: Announced when the saved presentation could not be read.

presentation.failed.context: A presentation save failed with no reason given.

presentation.failed.detail.context: A presentation save failed; the reason follows.

login.title.context: The sign-in page's browser tab title. 'DebridPulse' is the product name. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.unavailable.title.context: Tab title when sign-in cannot be offered right now. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.subtitle.context: Line under the DebridPulse name on the sign-in page. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.unavailable.context: Line under the DebridPulse name when sign-in cannot be offered. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.secure_access.context: Screen-reader text of the sign-in mark. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.username.context: Field label. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.username.placeholder.context: Field placeholder. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.password.context: Field label. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.password.placeholder.context: Field placeholder. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.password.show.context: Eye button's accessible name while the password is hidden. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.password.hide.context: Eye button's accessible name while it is held and the password shown. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.sign_in.context: Submits the sign-in form. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.sign_in_with.context: Signs in through the named identity provider. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.or_password.context: Divider between identity-provider sign-in and the password form. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.oidc_incomplete.context: Shown instead of the identity-provider button. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.not_required.context: Shown when no sign-in method is enabled. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.foot.http.context: Footnote about plain HTTP on a local network. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.foot.https.context: Footnote; {https} is the protocol name HTTPS, drawn emphasised. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.return.context: Link back to the sign-in page. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.challenges.context: Rate limit before a sign-in form is issued. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.oidc_challenges.context: Rate limit on identity-provider sign-ins. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.password_disabled.context: A password sign-in arrived while password sign-in is off. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.invalid_request.context: The sign-in request was malformed. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.expired.context: The form's anti-forgery token expired. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.busy.context: Too many password checks at once. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.invalid_password.context: Standalone sign-in: the password is wrong. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.invalid_credentials.context: Server sign-in: the username or password is wrong (never says which). Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.config_changed.context: Sign-in raced a configuration change. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.config_changed_restart.context: Identity-provider sign-in raced a configuration change. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.oidc_disabled.context: An identity-provider sign-in arrived while it is off. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.oidc_unavailable.context: The identity provider could not be used. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.oidc_incomplete.context: The identity-provider sign-in did not finish. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.not_operational.context: The sign-in was genuine but the account is disabled or removed. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.

login.error.oidc_refused.context: The identity provider's answer was refused. Server-rendered before sign-in: plain {name} arguments only.
